desc: A legendary floating star spirit, round glowing lavender body with two small arms and no legs, crown of pale crystal spikes, wide gentle teal eyes, small gold rings orbiting. High quality 16-bit pixel art game pet, crisp pixels, right-facing 3/4 view, full body, dark violet outline, pixel cluster shading with clear light and shadow, palette of lavender, pale violet, cream, ivory and deep navy, no props, no background.
